title: Replace 30-day fixed evaluation window with a rolling perpetual model (currently day 187/30)
description: The firm is on day 187/30 of a fixed trading window. Fixed-window evaluation creates end-of-horizon distortions: agents and managers behave differently when the 'clock is running out'. More importantly, when day 30 ends, institutional memory resets. Proposal: remove the 30-day limit. Run perpetually. Generate a quarterly benchmark report (vs. SPY, QQQ, sector ETFs) every 63 trading days. Evaluate the firm on rolling 30/63/252-day Sharpe ratio, not a single fixed window. This is how real hedge funds measure themselves.
